name: Oakland Parks, Recreation and Youth Development (OPRYD) Part-Time Jobs
what_you_do: You can apply for part-time and seasonal City recreation jobs. Jobs include recreation aide, recreation leader, sports official, lifeguard, water safety instructor and pool staff. There is also a recreation specialist job.
who_can_apply: Age 15 for Lifeguard, with current Red Cross cards. Age 16 for Recreation Aide and Sports Official. Age 17 for Water Safety Instructor. Most other jobs need 18. You need a Social Security number to work for the City. People who speak Spanish, Cantonese and Mandarin are strongly encouraged to apply.
pay_detail: Paid job. Per hour: Recreation Aide from $17.65, Lifeguard from $21.70, Water Safety Instructor from $25.23, Sports Official $26.79.
deadline_text: The Oct 25, 2026 round for Spring or Summer 2027 starts has closed. Apply by Feb 7, 2027 for Summer 2027 starts, or by Aug 8, 2027 for Fall or Winter 2027 starts. Hiring takes several months.
how_to_apply: Apply at governmentjobs.com/careers/oaklandca. Questions: parksandrec@oaklandca.gov or (510) 238-7275.
notes: The hiring process takes several months, so apply early. You must bring your Social Security card to finish hiring. Hiring also includes fingerprints and a TB test. If you cannot find the posting, call (510) 238-7275.
